translations.web: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
translations.bsb: His roots wrap around the rock heap; he looks for a home among the stones.
translations.kjv: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
translations.asv: His roots are wrapped about the stone -heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.
